aitareya_chapter4_verse3.title: Aitareya Chapter 4 Verse 3
aitareya_chapter4_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Aitareya, Chapter 4.
aitareya_chapter4_verse3.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Aitareya Upanishad, Chapter 4, Verse 3, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
aitareya_chapter4_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
